articles.summary: Donaldson Company, Inc. (NYSE: DCI), a leading worldwide provider of innovative filtration products and solutions, today announced the appointment of Jeff Stierman as president of its Industrial Solutions segment, effective November 2, 2026. Stierman currently serves as senior vice president of Business Operations at Donaldson, leading environmental health and safety (EHS), procurement, supply chain, manufacturing excellence, facilities, customer service, engineering and laboratories. In his new role, he will continue to report to Rich Lewis, president and chief executive officer. “Jeff has a proven track record of leading businesses and building strong operating capabilities through a rigorous, disciplined approach,” said Lewis. “Industrial Solutions is integral to Donaldson’s long-term strategic and financial success and I am confident that Jeff’s leadership will position the segment for continued growth.” Stierman will continue to oversee Business Operations until a successor is
articles.title: Donaldson Appoints Jeff Stierman President of Industrial Solutions

articles.summary: Donaldson Company, Inc. (NYSE: DCI), a leading worldwide provider of innovative filtration products and solutions, today announced Rich Lewis, president and chief executive officer will present at the Gabelli Funds 50 th Annual Automotive Symposium on Monday, November 2 nd , beginning at 3:00 p.m. PST. WEBCAST: To listen to a live webcast of the presentation, visit the “Events Presentations” section of Donaldson’s Investor Relations website at IR.Donaldson.com and click on the “listen to webcast” option. About Donaldson Company Founded in 1915, Donaldson (NYSE: DCI) is a global leader in technology-led filtration products and solutions, serving a broad range of industries and advanced markets. Diverse, skilled employees at over 150 locations on six continents partner with customers – from small business owners to RD organizations and the world’s biggest OEM brands.
